t01-three-heights.observed_description: Sofia (blue blazer, left, shortest), Ana (sage overshirt, middle) and Luis (navy T-shirt, right, tallest) stand side by side against a light-grey wall, smiling.
t01-three-heights.note: Usable: shortest to tallest reads left to right at 180 px; all three stand on one floor.

t02-three-dogs.observed_description: Diego (burgundy shirt) stands in a park holding three leashes; in front of him sit a big black dog, a medium brown dog and a tiny white dog.
t02-three-dogs.note: Usable: biggest and smallest read at 180 px; exactly three dogs.

t03-three-houses.observed_description: A quiet street with three houses side by side: a big three-floor green house, a two-floor white house and a small one-floor red house; no people, cars or numbers.
t03-three-houses.note: Usable: the three sizes and colors read at 180 px.
